manufacturer_data.description: Passive scan. Accept only the eight environmental versions declared in protocol_details.advertisement_formats; reject all others.

methods.notes: No GATT connection, name filter, account or cloud is needed.

manufacturer_data.description: Blue Maestro. The payload after the two company-ID bytes starts with the advertisement version. Company ID alone is insufficient to emit readings: gateway versions 10, 100 and 101 and unknown versions must be ignored.

device.name: BlueMaestro Tempo Disc Environmental Sensors
device.notes:
Match company ID 0x0133 and then dispatch on the first manufacturer-payload byte. Versions 10, 100 and 101 are gateway-status formats, not environmental measurements, and are rejected. RSSI belongs to the receiver, not the sensor.
A packet shorter than its declared measurement layout is ignored in full. Trailing bytes after that layout are tolerated as statistics. Never decode a partial field or reuse the previous value after a truncated packet.
Only v13 and v23 have redacted physical-packet evidence in the public parser fixtures. Their `confirmed` markers mean exactly that limited interoperability evidence. Every other version is `reported`: synthetic app comparison does not prove hardware behavior or a retail-model mapping.
Integration is identify_only until a real handler implements these passive decoders; the protocol formats alone are not a supported mobile measurement surface.

openness.notes: Live readings are broadcast without a connection. The maintained parser and its public fixtures are the source here; connected logger and configuration operations are deliberately outside this spec.

pairing.notes: Passive monitoring needs no BLE pairing, bonding or application credential.

credentials.notes: Live values are unencrypted broadcasts. Any logger or cloud credentials are separate and not covered.

factory_reset.description: No manual or capture establishing a reset was reviewed. Do not probe configuration characteristics in search of one.
factory_reset.effect: No reset procedure or state cleared by one is established. Passive monitoring stores no bond, network membership or client credential on the sensor; connected history/configuration reset behavior is out of scope.

methods.description: Passively decode company-0x0133 advertisements; never connect for live values.

steps.action: Install or replace the battery according to the label on the unit.
Scan for manufacturer company ID 0x0133 and read the version byte.
Require the complete version-specific measurement layout, then decode it and ignore any trailing statistics.
steps.expect: Live measurements without a GATT connection; unsupported and truncated packets produce no update.

setup.notes: Fit the battery and listen. There is no provisioning or pairing for the measurement stream. Confidence is high for the public-capture-backed v13/v23 subset and medium for the family as a whole because the remaining versions have only synthetic app comparisons.

rejoin.notes: There is no network or host binding to move. A replacement controller simply scans.

steps.action: Scan from the replacement controller and retain the same version-specific decoder.
steps.expect: The next complete advertisement produces a reading; no old controller is needed.

testing.notes: No device was connected or configured by this project. Version 13 and 23 layouts are checked against redacted public physical-advertisement fixtures; every other version has synthetic app-versus-parser evidence only. Fixture agreement is not calibrated physical-accuracy verification.

LegacyTHD.description: Versions 22 and 23; big-endian temperature, humidity and transmitted dew point.

fields.description: Signed int16 at offsets 10-11; preserve, never recompute
fields.name: dew_point_transmitted

parse_rules: Require at least 12 bytes. Ignore the entire packet when shorter; accept trailing statistics.
Decode all three environmental values by dividing by 10; dew point is the transmitted field, not the app's calculated value.

LegacyTHPD.description: Version 27; big-endian temperature, humidity and unsigned pressure.
parse_rules: Require at least 12 bytes. Ignore the entire packet when shorter; accept trailing statistics.
Do not add a dew-point field to this parser's v27 surface; the maintained passive parser does not expose one.

LegacyTemperature.description: Versions 8 and 13; offsets include the version byte but exclude company ID; multi-byte values are big-endian.
parse_rules: Require at least 8 bytes. Ignore the entire packet when shorter; accept trailing statistics.
temperature = int16be(bytes 6-7) / 10 C; battery = byte 1 percent.

MaxiTHD.description: Version 42; little-endian with calculated, not transmitted, dew point.
parse_rules: Require at least 19 bytes; reject truncation and tolerate trailing statistics.
Calculate dew point only as protocol_details.maxi_dew_point specifies; humidity <= 0 or > 100 yields unknown.

MaxiTHPD.description: Version 43; little-endian with a signed 32-bit pressure field.
parse_rules: Require at least 23 bytes; reject truncation and tolerate trailing statistics.
Calculate dew point using protocol_details.maxi_dew_point; it is absent on the wire.
Require at least 17 bytes; reject truncation and tolerate trailing statistics.

maxi_dew_point.formula: alpha = ln(humidity_percent / 100) + 17.67 * temperature_c / (temperature_c + 243.5). dew_point_c = floor(243.5 * alpha / (17.67 - alpha) * 100 + 0.5) / 100.
maxi_dew_point.notes: Use natural logarithm and round half up to 0.01 C exactly as written. Never substitute this calculation for the transmitted v22/v23 field.

test_vectors.evidence: Redacted public physical fixture; demonstrates why transmitted dew point wins
test_vectors.name: v23_public_transmitted_dew_point

remaining_unknowns: Exact retail model names for v8 and the Mini/Maxi variants must come from labels or primary documents, not version-byte guesses.
Physical advertisement captures are still needed for v8, v22, v27, v41, v42 and v43.
Logger history, calibration, configuration, firmware update and reset semantics are deliberately not claimed.
App comparison should be repeated on 13.8.7 before treating it as byte-identical to the 13.8.4 reference.
